I've attached a draft agenda (RBW-CloudBridge-workshop-agenda-v1.pdf) and a short checklist we typically use. Lauren will own workshop coordination on our side. Vivek (cc'ed on follow-up) will lead the deep-dive.

Thanks,

Marissa / Samiha — I can do Feb 18 at 11:00 AM EST. Proposed tech agenda items (90m):

1) Quick intros (5m)
2) Deployment options overview (15m) — hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private
3) Network & auth patterns (20m) — VPC peering, PrivateLink, KMS integration
4) Data flow & caching strategy (15m) — KV cache, prefix caching, telemetry hooks
5) Marketplace integration checklist (15m) — billing, metering, AMI/container packaging
6) Q&A + action items (20m)

I'm putting a first-pass architecture diagram in our shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-arch (architecture_diagram_v1.png). Please review and flag anything to add. I'll also create the calendar invite and include a dial-in/recording option.
